description: This file defines the class `EditSmartViewModalController`, a component managing user interactions for editing smart views within a web application. It handles state, validation, and communication with the application mutator for saving and deleting views.

classes.name: EditSmartViewModalController
classes.description: A controller class to manage the editing lifecycle of a smart view, including UI state, validation, and persisting changes.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Updates the title of the smart view.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon used for the smart view.

methods.name: setPredicateJson
methods.description: Assigns the JSON string representing the predicate.

methods.name: setIsPredicateJsonValid
methods.description: Marks whether the current predicate JSON is valid.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a given smart view, populating its state.

methods.name: setIsSaving
methods.description: Indicates whether a save operation is in progress.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Resets state and closes the editing modal/dialog.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current smart view state via the application's mutator.

methods.name: deleteView
methods.description: Deletes the current smart view after user confirmation.

methods.name: validateAndPrettifyCustomPredicate
methods.description: Validates the predicate JSON and formats it prettily if valid.
